mapper.select: select * from coupon where status = 1 order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into coupon(name, type, discount_amount, discount_rate, min_amount, max_discount, total_count, used_count, valid_days, start_time, end_time, status, description) values(#{name}, #{type}, #{discountAmount}, #{discountRate}, #{minAmount}, #{maxDiscount}, #{totalCount}, #{usedCount}, #{validDays}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{description})
mapper.update: update coupon set used_count = #{usedCount} where id = #{id}
